annotations.title: Ask the person for their images

description: Gives a link where the person uploads pictures from their device for you — their logo, photos, a signature scan — when you cannot take the file from the chat yourself (you see an attached picture but have no file of it, or they have not sent it yet). Give them the link and say what to upload. When they say they are done, call ask_for_images again with upload_id: you get each image's link (with its size and file name) to put in the document — render_pdf, update_document. A program with the file (a shell, a code sandbox) can POST its bytes to the same link instead. The link works for 24 hours and takes up to 50 images — photos straight from a phone or a camera too (HEIC, up to 40 MB each; brought to print size, 4096 px on the long side).

note.description: What to upload, shown to the person on the page, e.g. "Your company logo (PNG with a transparent background is best)". Only for a new link.

upload_id.description: The upload_id of a link you gave: what the person has uploaded to it so far.

name: ask_for_images
